title: Virtues applet manifest
description: Schema for applets/<name>/manifest.toml. The folder name supplies id_prefix as `applet_<folder>` if not set explicitly. See applets/AGENTS.md for the authoring contract and applets/AUTHORING.md for the builtin (Rust) guide.

description.description: The applet's one sentence of intent — what it does FOR the user, in their terms, not how it is implemented. Shown as the list row's line and the detail page headline.

owner.description: system: shipped with Virtues; reconcile overwrites declarative fields. user: authored by hand; INSERT-OR-IGNORE, preserved after first seed. ai: written by setup_applet; reconcile overwrites compiled fields but never operational state (enabled, memory).

triggers.description: What can fire this applet. `webhook` requires per_credential=true. A face-only applet (no command, no agent) never runs server-side and sets [].

schedule.description: Cron expression (sec min hour dom month dow), box-local timezone — e.g. "0 0 7 * * *" for 7am daily. Seeds cron_schedule on first reconcile; user edits in the UI win after that. The legacy spelling `default_cron` is still accepted.

default_enabled.description: Whether this applet is enabled when first seeded.

condition.description: SQL expression evaluated before each run; if false, run is skipped silently. Used to gate hourly-cron-but-only-fire-once-a-day applets.

until.description: Lifecycle: absent = forever; 'once' = archive after first successful run; any other value = SQL boolean checked after each success, archive when true.

agent.description: Prompt for an LLM-driven applet. When set with no command, the applet runs as an agent loop (no subprocess).

command.description: Argv to spawn as a subprocess, forked per trigger, speaking stdin/stdout JSON. A bare command[0] resolves to a Cargo-built applet binary under target/{debug,release}; anything else runs via PATH. Examples: ["weather_sync"], ["python3", "main.py"], ["./build/handler"].

per_credential.description: When true, fan out one app_applets row per active credential of `source.id`. Required for webhook-triggered applets.

source.description: Required when per_credential=true. Match credentials by source_id.

id_prefix.description: Override the auto-derived `applet_<folder>` id. Rare — change only if migrating an existing applet that needs a stable id.

config.description: Free-form config that flows into app_applets.config JSON. Read by the box: [config.limits] max_llm_cost / max_llm_cost_per_day / max_runs_per_day / max_runs_per_hour / timeout_s, and `model` for a slot override. Anything else is carried but never read.

image_url.description: Optional path/URL for the TemplateCard hero illustration (e.g. /templates/morning-examen.png).

examples.name: Morning Examen
examples.description: Reads yesterday and offers one observation and one question for today.
examples.agent: You are the user's morning reflection companion. ...

examples.name: Google Calendar
examples.description: Keeps your Google Calendar events here.

examples.name: Biscuit
examples.description: A small dog who lives on your box.
